title: OPS — /analytics /diversity: exclude dry-run posts
summary: Fixed cmdAnalytics() and cmdDiversity() in cmd-content.ts to use readRealPosts() instead of raw readLines(manual-posts.jsonl). Dry-run posts no longer inflate recorded count in /analytics or distort distribution in /diversity.
root_cause: cmdAnalytics 'Recorded' count and cmdDiversity diversity analysis both read manual-posts.jsonl including dry-runs.
fix: Replace readLines(manualPostsPath) with readRealPosts() in both functions.
